items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I know Lizzie well. Your honey Wilhelmina was well-friendly.

ctx.x: I met her once when Lizzie Miles was working on Bergen Street. She came by to hear Lizzie. She used to be a friend of her.

Friend of Liz. I'm a Lizzie girl. Her name was Lizzie Pazio, for you. Oh, yeah. She still uses that name. My, yeah. I know Lizzie well. Your honey Wilhelmina was well-friendly. Her name is now Wilhelmina Durone.
